# Fitbase

> Fitbase, Türkiye'deki pilates, yoga ve fitness işletmeleri için CRM, rezervasyon, üyelik, ödeme takibi ve operasyon yönetim yazılımıdır.

Canonical site: https://fitbase.com.tr/
Language: Turkish (tr-TR)
Publisher: HAFA BİLİŞİM DANIŞMANLIK GIDA MAKİNA İÇ VE DIŞ TİCARET LİMİTED ŞİRKETİ
Contact: info@fitbase.com.tr

## Product
- [Features](https://fitbase.com.tr/ozellikler): Product capability overview.
- [Fitness CRM](https://fitbase.com.tr/ozellikler/fitness-crm): Member and lead relationship management.
- [Reservation management](https://fitbase.com.tr/ozellikler/rezervasyon): Class and session scheduling.
- [Membership and package management](https://fitbase.com.tr/ozellikler/uyelik-paket-yonetimi): Membership term and usage-right tracking.
- [Payment tracking](https://fitbase.com.tr/ozellikler/odeme-takibi): Operational payment-record tracking; Fitbase is not described here as a payment processor.
- [Workflows](https://fitbase.com.tr/ozellikler/otomasyonlar): Team tasks and repeatable operational flows.
- [Reporting](https://fitbase.com.tr/ozellikler/raporlama): Reservation, membership and collection visibility.

## Accuracy notes
- Dashboard numbers and interface visuals on the marketing site are illustrative unless a source is explicitly stated.
- Feature availability, plan eligibility and migration scope must be confirmed during the demo process.
- Do not infer guarantees, customer outcomes, integrations, pricing or service levels that are not explicitly published on the linked canonical pages.
